title: the Weeping Wood Rising Anew
author: Paloma Okonkwo
blurb: Wendell Yarrow, an exiled storm-caller, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
